svg.title: The Node Board: Swiss relief map
svg.desc: The Node Board (1D): the core board laid on a Swiss-style shaded relief map of the Peaks, with contours and twelve nodes joined by coupling lines whose thickness is their strength. Emitters sit on numbered firing slots; two opposite-phase emitters have cancelled one edge to a dashed line. After the trigger, damped nodes show green rings and amplifying ones red starbursts, N12 among them, and the Strain bar at the top stays over the calm line.
